name: Test of Lore
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Your time with me is just about finished. I am knowledgeable, but the Test of Lore is not mine to give. There are lessons to be learned and places to visit that others claim domain over.

If you are prepared, then seek out Braug Dimspirit--he is a shaman of great wisdom. He will test you further, so heed his words, adventurer.

When you are ready, find the tunnel that connects the Stonetalon Mountains with Ashenvale: Braug dwells near there. And be careful, adventurer, the night elves may wish to impede your test.
narrative.objectives: Find Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The days and nights grow colder throughout the world as goblins rape the land, and the night elves point fingers at the younger races. The Forsaken and orcs are not the only ones to blame for the hardships found throughout Kalimdor and Lordaeron. Many of the intelligent races have contributed to the world's pain. Dorn knows this, and he has sent you to me because you have shown the attributes necessary to realize it also.

Now you stand before Braug.

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 26 to 36, 17,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Test of Faith
quests.objectiveText: If you have faith, leap from the planks overlooking Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Endurance
quests.objectiveText: Bring Grenka's Claw to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Strength
quests.objectiveText: Bring Fragments of Rok'Alim to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Find Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Find the Legacy of the Aspects and return it to Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Find The Beginnings of the Undead Threat, and return it to Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again.

quests.name: Final Passage
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
